correctness.rationale: For all q>=3, the closed-ball formula R_b union K_a union own membership is exact. At most one empty row and column gives the q lower bound; 3,4,5-symbol templates have complete nonempty, distinct signature matrices, and a disjoint-block lemma proves the q+floor(q/3) upper bound. The sharp first three cases use exhaustive independent enumeration of 84, 1820 and 53130 size-q subsets, and monotonicity excludes all smaller sizes. The checker can be run from its embedded path.

value.rationale: A constructive family of at most 4q/3 sensors identifies all q^2 vertices in a fault-location network, within a factor at most 4/3 of the proved lower bound q. This is a mathematically motivated scalable response to the 2015 undirected minimum-code and efficient-construction questions, with fully exact initial alphabet cases; it is not a routine substitution of a known directed optimal code.
